content.text: Is this supposed to be talking about CMA disseminations?
Yes. Edit: Which I guess is the irony of me doing it.
Do we want to do this the other way around (i.e. a ticket to explore ideas of dissemination in F4, then we think about how to migrate)?
I worry that starting with F3 CMA is going to make legacy weight the driving force in design.
Would it be useful to start with:
That's definitely part of the picture. I would want to understand better whether or not this is really about metadata or content generally.
Agreed, this is a very open-ended ticket. Additional scoping would be helpful.

Closing as part of a jira repository effort.  It is being closed for one of the following reasons:  1) it is no longer applicable,  2) it has been fixed in future version or 3) no one seems to be interested in it .
Explore ways to provide type-dependent behaviors in Fedora 4, as a near-analog for migrating Fedora 3 repos.
